entities.name: Sanzō Wada
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sanzo Wada  was a Japanese painter and costume designer who won the Academy Award for Best Costume Design for his work on the jidaigeki film Gate of Hell (1953). Wada reorganized the Japan Standard Color Association into the Japan Color Research Laboratory in 1945, and served as its president.

Wada reorganized the Japan Standard Color Association into the Japan Color Research Laboratory in 1945, and served as its president.
